Since 2001, InfraredSaunaParts have consistently and continuously supply infrared sauna parts to many saunas across the country. We’re the leading infrared sauna parts and take pride in what we do. Making sure all our clients are satisfied with our products, we like to maintain the relationship by being that one company they can rely on.

Many infrared sauna parts suppliers go out of business after a while, leaving many sauna owners without a supplier. Due to this, many sauna owners either go out of business themselves or they have to resort to cheaper and low quality sauna parts sold by shady companies.

“When my supplier went out of business, I didn’t know where else I could find the things I need for the chromotherapy at my sauna. A friend told me about InfraredSaunaParts and I when I saw their catalogue, I knew I didn’t have to look elsewhere anymore!”

T. Clara, Atlantic City, NJ

Clara came to us looking for replacements for LED lights for her chromotherapy treatment in her sauna. And she was glad to know how wide our range of chromotherapy lights are.

In some infrared sauna, the use of chromotherapy is popular among customers because it’s known to help restore balance in a person’s emotional, physical, and spiritual aspects. Chromotherapy, or color lights therapy, uses the many different colored lights on someone’s body by applying them at the right position based on the human’s physique and chakras. This technique has been used for many years by Ayurveda and traditional Chinese medicine practitioners and has recently been popular in infrared saunas.

For all your chromotherapy needs, why not contact us today to find out how else we can help you with your infrared sauna business.
